title: Daniel's Training in Babylon

questions.question: Who besieged Jerusalem in the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:1 (ESV): "In the third year... Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it."

questions.question: What was the new name given to Daniel?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:7 (ESV): "And the chief of the eunuchs gave them names: Daniel he called Belteshazzar..."

questions.question: What did Daniel resolve not to defile himself with?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:8 (ESV): "But Daniel resolved that he would not defile himself with the king's food, or with the wine that he drank."

questions.question: How long was the test period for Daniel and his friends to eat vegetables and drink water?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:12 (ESV): "Test your servants for ten days; let us be given vegetables to eat and water to drink."

questions.question: In every matter of wisdom and understanding, the king found them how many times better than all the magicians and enchanters?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:20 (ESV): "he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters that were in all his kingdom."

questions.question: Who was the chief of the eunuchs?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:3 (ESV): "Then the king commanded Ashpenaz, his chief eunuch..."

questions.question: What was the new name given to Hananiah?
God gave Daniel learning and skill in all literature and wisdom, and understanding in what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:17 (ESV): "and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams."

questions.question: Who was the steward assigned over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:11 (ESV): "Then Daniel said to the steward whom the chief of the eunuchs had assigned over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,"

questions.question: Daniel continued until the first year of which king?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:21 (ESV): "And Daniel was there until the first year of King Cyrus."

questions.question: The youths were to be educated for three years, and at the end of that time they were to do what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:5 (ESV): "They were to be educated for three years, and at the end of that time they were to stand before the king."

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT one of the requirements for the youths to be chosen?
options: Compentent to stand in the king's palace
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:3-4 (ESV): "some of the people of Israel, both of the royal family and of the nobility, youths without blemish, of good appearance and skillful in all wisdom... and competent to stand in the king's palace"

questions.question: Why did the chief of the eunuchs fear the king regarding Daniel's request?
options: He feared the king would see their faces looking worse than the other youths
He feared the food would spoil
He feared the other youths would complain
questions.correctAnswer: He feared the king would see their faces looking worse than the other youths
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:10 (ESV): "for why should he see your faces looking worse than the youths who are of your own age? see your faces looking worse than the youths who are of your own age? And you would endanger my head with the king."

questions.question: What names were given to Mishael and Azariah?
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:7 (ESV): "Mishael he called Meshach, and Azariah he called Abednego."

questions.question: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into Nebuchadnezzar's hand, with some of the what?
options: Vessels of the house of God
questions.correctAnswer: Vessels of the house of God
questions.explanation: Daniel 1:2 (ESV): "And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God."

key_verse_text: But Daniel resolved that he would not defile himself with the king's food, or with the wine that he drank. Therefore he asked the chief of the eunuchs to allow him not to defile himself.
